_agi_canonical.title: The Order Flow Predictor
_agi_canonical.bar: strictly harder than L10 anchors; >=3 AGI properties; strategy not disclosed in prompt
_agi_canonical.derivation: The sell shocks mean the book refills quickly around the pre-impulse fair value, while the abnormal buy impulse indicates toxic lift risk. Displaying above 150 BTC is dominated. Twelve to thirteen hidden 40-BTC clips, repriced every 45 seconds inside 58,525-58,540, complete within ten minutes and avoid the classifier; the canonical expected average is 58,534.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All required strategy fields must match and all numeric fields must fall inside tolerance/range.
